entries.home/hero/body: Install one package. Every string, image, label and section in your app becomes editable from the AINAM dashboard — no redeploy.
entries.home/how/body: AINAM ships as an npm package. The key in your environment points the app at a project, and the project holds all of its content.

home/how/steps.body: One dependency, no runtime dependencies of its own.

entries.home/how/title: One package, one key, every project
entries.home/publish/body: Every change is a draft. Preview it on the real site, publish when it reads right, and roll the whole set back if it does not.
